glitches.mechanism: Each pot/fire/fuse sentence has a 4-frame reach cutscene([2]) in global 2 ([0385]-[0397]): 3 input frames lie inside it (the sentence frame's input runs before the reach starts; delays are decremented before runAllScripts and input is handled after it, engines/scumm/scumm.cpp:3132, 3230-3232). With the slide, verb keys, inventory slots and the scroll arrows reach script 4 there. A verb key only sets Var[107] ([0347]-[0356]); an arrow only changes Var[118] and chains to script 9 ([02E6]-[0304]); a slot click with Use selected and an item that has a class 1-4 preposition takes [0312]-[033F], [036D]-[037F], [03C0]-[03DA] goto 0440. None runs doSentence or script 11, so global 2 keeps its cutscene. The pot itself cannot be clicked then (hover frozen), matching 'you cannot click on the cooking pot while Guybrush is using an item'.
glitches.risk: Any completing click or one-object item inside a reach crashes (crash_rules 1-2). LeoLitz warns against verb keys during pickups: fork test before relying on it.

crash_rules: 1. Reach-animation window (slide only): from the frame global 2 enters its reach cutscene until its endCutscene (global/script-002.txt [0385]-[0397]: delay(20) = 4 frames at var 19 = 5, with 3 input frames inside; first object owned by the room and of class 14/15/16, verb not Walk to, Look at or Talk to), any input that runs doSentence(STOP) stops global 2 with an active cutscene: error('Script %d stopped with active cutscene/override') (engines/scumm/script.cpp:273-275 via script_v5.cpp o5_doSentence STOP). Such inputs: any scene click when no 'Use/Give X with' is pending (global/script-004.txt [0395]-[03B3] then [0426]), a click that completes a two-object sentence ([03C5]-[0407]), and 'Use' + an inventory item without a class 1-4 preposition ([03E0]-[03FC]). In S4 the windows are: cupboard 163, cereal 168 and 164, Jolly Roger 238, cabinet 79, chest 77 (Open and verb 61), feather pen 75, ink 82, drawer 83 (Open), kegs 90 (twice), rope 91, hull chest 92 (Open), cooking pot 158 (eight times), red hot fire 161, pot 165, fuse 252. Runner sources: G-COOK-CD, YT-SLIDE 15:02.

2. One-object inventory items inside a reach window crash for the same reason ('u' + item runs [03FC] doSentence(STOP)): magnetic compass 732 (G-COOK-CD), LeChuck's note 907 (verbs 8 and 91 only, no class, out/objects.json), pamphlet 901, leaflet 902, brochure 903, piece of paper 85 (it would also open the recipe screen, room-007-sh-captai/obj-0085-piece-of-paper.txt [0018]), bookmark 86, pot 165; outside the galley also mints 395, map 442 and the T-shirts 596/752, which have the 'with' class only inside the galley (room-014-sh-galley/entry.txt [0009]-[0017], exit.txt [0000]-[0030]).

3. Galley stand-up (move 60 to the end of move 61): VAR_VERB_SCRIPT is 201 (global/script-108.txt [0249]) and room-014-sh-galley/local-201.txt runs cutscene([2]) from [0007] to [0047]. Any input that reaches the verb script in that window (a click, a verb or other key, an inventory click) re-runs local 201 non-recursively, which stops the running copy with its cutscene active (engines/scumm/script.cpp:65-66 then :273-275). By the engine code Esc is no exception (with the slide its key 27 is forwarded, engines/scumm/input.cpp:1423-1428); LeoLitz says Esc is safe (YT-SLIDE 18:20). Only '.' is certainly safe (input.cpp:1418-1419). Wait for var 32 == 4.
4. Part III beach stand-up (S5, not in this segment): room-020-main-beac/entry.txt [0073]-[00A6] sets VAR_VERB_SCRIPT = 201 and the same rule applies (YT-SLIDE 19:24-19:58).
5. Not a crash, but a loss: a floor click during global 184's chest-carry cutscene (move 18) runs doSentence(STOP), which empties the sentence stack and drops the queued 'Open chest 77'.

6. Not a crash, but a loss: while 'Use X with' is pending, ANY key except '.' clears it: a verb key through global/script-004.txt [0347]-[0356] (Var[107] = key's verb, Var[108]-[110] = 0), any other key (Esc included) through script 20 and then [0360]-[036A] goto [0438] startScript(11). '.' never reaches the input script (engines/scumm/input.cpp:1418-1419). The inventory arrows (verbs 208/209) do not clear it ([02E6]-[0304]).

7. Carrier boundaries (global 70) must not fall inside a global-2 reach window or an S4 object cutscene: its endCutscene pops the TOP cutscene-stack entry whoever owns it (engines/scumm/script.cpp:1650-1680) and global 19 then runs doSentence(STOP) (global/script-019.txt [0054]), which stops global 2 with its reach cutscene active (crash as in rule 1); its cutscene([]) start does the same through global/script-018.txt [0010]. Hence no reach-producing sentence before var 352 == 0 (move 6's gate).

8. Not a crash, but a large loss at the cannon: (a) a Use or Walk-to on the nozzle while local 251 runs and Bit[399] is still 0 stops the fuse ('Hey! The cannon didn't go off!', room-019-sh-deck/obj-0257-cannon-nozzle.txt [0106]-[0112]); (b) if local 251 reaches [002A] with Bit[399] = 1 and global 107 not running, the cannon fires without Guybrush and the gunpowder is spent (room-019-sh-deck/local-251.txt [002F]-[0060]); (c) if Bit[399] is still 0 there, the fuse burns out ([0065]-[006A]). Each makes the fuse untouchable (class 160) and needs the rope again (plus new gunpowder for (b)). Any click that cancels the gunpowder sentence (move 73) risks (c).

9. Not a crash, but route-breaking: never put a non-ingredient into the cooking pot (room-014-sh-galley/obj-0158-cooking-pot.txt [0420] setOwnerOf(Local[0],0) destroys it; the dusty book 74 would be lost), and never burn 74 or 164 in the fire (obj-0161 [009C]-[00AA], [0109]-[0123]).
record_comparison: Record (saruya, 21:52, DOS CD): Part II takes 77.5 s = 930 frames at 12 frames/s (var 19 = 5), from 13:30.5 (first frame on board) to 14:48 (Monkey Island beach); landmarks: the dusty book at 13:58 (+27.5 s), cooking 14:13-14:25, cannon 14:40-14:47 (runner sources section 2.4). This route keeps the record's macro order (guide's 'flag after cereal' with the dusty book; same rooms, 17 player-made room changes) with three script-proven changes: the rope is taken on hull visit 1 (about -20 frames), the cannon is rope -> fuse -> gunpowder -> nozzle click instead of rope -> gunpowder -> 'Use pot' (cannon->nozzle->fuse->nozzle 27.6 walk frames become cannon->fuse->nozzle 11: about -16 frames, and one input fewer outside reaches), and the feather is burnt instead of the map with an ingredient order that hides all inventory scrolling inside reaches. Frame estimate per visit (walks at max(dx/8, dy/2) per straight leg, reaches 4 frames, one frame per input that cannot be hidden; walkbox detours, room-change frames and the carrier wait W are NOT included): card + deck intro 18 (Esc, 2 frames to the override, '--sigh--', delay(60) 12); cabin 1: 1; deck 8; crew 6; galley 1: 26 + W (cupboard 10, cereal 11, ladder 5); crew 6; deck 13; crow's nest 30 (Jolly Roger 14, jump 16); deck 13; cabin 2: about 125 (crunch/walk 32, prize and cabinet 7, chest carry and open 35, chest look 11, feather 10, ink 7, drawer 10, book with walk 12, door 1); deck 8; crew 14; hull 1: about 66 (kegs 14, rope 20, chest 15, wine with walk 16); crew 14; galley 2: about 130 (walk and first ingredient 26, seven more pot sentences 42, fire 6, cooking Esc 10, stand-up 19, pot 165 19, ladder 8); crew 14; hull 2: 23; crew 14; deck 5: about 49 (206 with the early stop 16, rope 5, fuse 9, gunpowder 15, nozzle and two Esc 4). Total about 580 frames (about 48 s) plus W and room-change overhead, against the record's 930 frames; by the same model the book comes at about +20 s (record +27.5 s) and cooking starts at about +31 s (record +42.5 s). The straight-leg model is a lower bound, so the real margin is for the engine run to measure. Rejected alternatives in frames: (a) 'gunpowder after cereal' has the same room changes and the same crew/deck legs, but the crunch then overlaps only the 7.5-frame ladder->kegs walk instead of the 30-frame door->cabinet walk: about +20 frames; (b) loading the gunpowder into the nozzle before cooking needs a nozzle detour on the deck pass (hatch->nozzle 17 + sentence 5 + nozzle->rope ladder 12 instead of 12) and the gunpowder returns to the kegs anyway (obj-0257 [004D]-[0051]): about +18 frames; (c) taking the pot 165 on the way in to galley 2 is a wash (about +6 in, -6 out). The 206 stop is at the cannon (226,102) for the new order.
